extracted.intended_audience: researchers, policymakers, municipal practitioners and advocates working on citizen/public participation and participatory democracy
extracted.subtask_description: Collection of legal provisions, handbooks, municipal ‘Leitlinien’ and international codes that specify how to design, run and evaluate citizen/public participation processes (e.g., statutes, manuals, eight-step procedures, citizens’ assemblies, EU instruments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Öffentlichkeitsbeteiligungsgesetz — §9 Beteiligung der Öffentlichkeit
rubrics_metrics.description: „§ 9 Beteiligung der Öffentlichkeit. (Absatz 1) Die zuständige Behörde hat die Öffentlichkeit zu den Umweltauswirkungen des Vorhabens zu beteiligen. Der betroffenen Öffentlichkeit wird im Rahmen der Beteiligung Gelegenheit zur Äußerung gegeben.“ (Gesetz über die Öffentlichkeitsbeteiligung in Umweltangelegenheiten nach der EG‑Richtlinie 2003/35/EG).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal requirement: authorities must involve the public on environmental impacts and provide the affected public an opportunity to express views. Cited as national implementation of EU Directive 2003/35/EG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code of Good Practice for Civil Participation in the Decision‑Making Process (Verhaltenskodex)
rubrics_metrics.description: „Code of Good Practice for Civil Participation in the Decision‑Making Process. Background. In: Konferenz der INGOs (internationale Nichtregierungsorganisationen). Europarat, 1. Oktober 2009 (deutsch: Verhaltenskodex für die Bürgerbeteiligung im Entscheidungsprozess).“
rubrics_metrics.guidance: International / Council of Europe recommendation-style code setting principles and good practices for civil participation in decision-making; presented as a normative reference for design and evaluation of participation processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manual for Good Public Participation — Planning of major projects (Federal level handbook)
rubrics_metrics.description: Manual/guidance titled Manual for Good Public Participation – Planning of major projects in the transport sector (and German 'Handbuch für eine gute Bürgerbeteiligung').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical handbook referenced for participation in large infrastructure/transport projects; used as a model/manual for designing major-project public participation processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handbook / Handbuch Bürgerbeteiligung (for Länder and municipalities)
rubrics_metrics.description: References to handbooks such as 'Handbuch Bürgerbeteiligung für Land und Gemeinden' (Amt der Vorarlberger Landesregierung) and Praxisbuch Partizipation (Magistrat Wien).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational guidance documents collecting methods, templates and principles; cited as resources for practitioners at regional and municipal levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Municipal 'Leitlinien' (Guidelines) for citizen participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Numerous municipal 'Leitlinien' are cited (e.g. Leitlinien Bürgerbeteiligung Bonn; Leitlinien zur Beteiligung der Bürgerinnen und Bürger in der Wissenschaftsstadt Darmstadt; Leitlinien in Wuppertal, Heidelberg, Heilbronn, Karlsruhe, Kiel, Landau, Leipzig, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Municipal-level guiding documents adopted by city councils that set out institutional approaches, principles and procedures for local participation. Often formalized via council resolution and used as the basis for local participation practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bürgerbeteiligungssatzung (statutory/bylaw approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: References to formal statutes/bylaws for participation (e.g. 'Bürgerbeteiligungssatzung der Universitätsstadt Gießen' and 'Satzung zur Weiterführung der Bürgerbeteiligung' Weyarn).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal/administrative codification of participation rules at municipal level — creates binding procedures, responsibilities and structured participation mechanisms (i.e., formalizes who, when and how citizens are involved).

rubrics_metrics.name: Spielregeln / Acht Schritte zur Bürgerbeteiligung (ground rules / step procedures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples like 'Spielregeln für Bürgerbeteiligung in Überlingen. Acht Schritte zur Bürgerbeteiligung' and references to 'Gemeinsame Spielregeln'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Process-oriented checklists or stepwise procedures (e.g., eight concrete steps) and 'ground rules' for running participation activities — used to structure engagement and set mutual expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Konzept zur systematischen Bürgerbeteiligung / Beteiligungskonzept
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents such as 'Konzept zur systematischen Bürgerbeteiligung' (Stadt Karlsruhe), 'Beteiligungskonzept' (Landkreis Marburg‑Biedenkopf) and other concept papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strategic concept documents that lay out objectives, methods, target groups, communication and governance arrangements for a systematic approach to public participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion/accessibility principle — 'Damit alle mitmachen können.'
rubrics_metrics.description: Phrase cited in the Darmstadt 'Leitlinien zur Beteiligung...': 'Damit alle mitmachen können.' (so that everyone can participate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit normative guideline emphasizing inclusivity and accessibility of participation processes (design and measures to enable broad and equitable participation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Hudson Ladder / HSE 'Kulturleiter' applied to participation and crisis communication
rubrics_metrics.description: References to Patrick Hudson's 'Implementing a safety culture ...' and the 'HSE Culture ladder (Hudson Ladder)', with citation of 'Krisenkommunikation in Beteiligungsprozessen' using the 'Hudson Ladder' in participation processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of a maturity/culture-ladder model (originally safety culture) as an evaluative/diagnostic tool for organizational culture around participation and for structuring crisis communication approaches in engagement processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliberative/democratic innovations: Citizens' assemblies / Bürgerräte / Bürgerforum / Citizens' Dialogues
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple references to deliberative formats (Bürgerrat, Citizens' Assembly, Citizens' Dialogues, BürgerForum, G1000, Citizens’ Assembly of Scotland/Ireland/Wales etc.). Includes descriptions of sortition ('Per Los ins Gremium'), deliberation and practical projects (e.g., Bürgerrat zur Klimapolitik).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formats and procedural models that use random selection/sortition and structured deliberation to produce citizen recommendations; referenced as a class of methods with examples, use-cases and debates on legitimacy/impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participatory Budgeting and Participatory Tools (e.g., participatory budgeting evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.description: References to internal evaluations/research on Participatory Budgeting (e.g., 'Participatory Budgeting: Abklärungen und Bewertungen' in Zurich) and to software/tools (GitHub references for BürgerForum materials).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As a participation tool, participatory budgeting is presented as a method requiring evaluation and assessment (costs, governance implications); mentions of tooling and digital platforms are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliberative Polling / Considered Opinions (Fishkin/Jowell/Luskin)
rubrics_metrics.description: Citation of James S. Fishkin, Roger Jowell, Robert C. Luskin: 'Considered Opinions: Deliberative Polling in Britain.' (British Journal of Political Science 2002).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methodological approach combining random sampling and structured deliberation to measure considered public opinion; presented as an established deliberative technique.

rubrics_metrics.name: European participatory mechanisms — Citizens’ Dialogues, European Citizens' Initiative, Agora
rubrics_metrics.description: Mentions of EU-level mechanisms: 'Citizens' Dialogues across the EU', 'European Citizens' Initiative (ECI)', 'Agora' (EU Parliament forum), Commission reports on Citizens' Dialogues, and related initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EU institutional instruments and forums for engaging citizens transnationally; cited as part of the broader participatory ecosystem and as sources of practice/guidance at supranational level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance and evaluations from research and NGOs (handbooks, evaluation reports, databases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Numerous references to evaluation studies, databases and NGO materials (e.g., 'Evaluating public input in National Park Management Plan reviews', 'Datenbank Bürgerbegehren' IDPF, 'Zusammenfassung der Ergebnisse der Datenbank dialogorientierte Beteiligungsverfahren').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Empirical/evaluation resources and compilations used to assess the effectiveness of participation procedures; cited as evidence base for designing and judging participation measures.
